theorem etcdstart.memberBuilt.congr_simp (s s✝ : Loc) (e_s : s = s✝) (ρ ρ✝ : ReqNames) (e_ρ : ρ =
    ρ✝) (E₀ E₀✝ : apply.AEnv GF) (e_E₀ : E₀ = E₀✝) (lg lg✝ : Loc) (e_lg : lg = lg✝) (γn γn✝ :
    NetNames GF) (e_γn : γn = γn✝) (id id✝ : w64) (e_id : id = id✝) (N N✝ : Nat) (e_N : N = N✝)
    (served served✝ : Bool) (e_served : served = served✝) (ai₀ ai₀✝ : w64) (e_ai₀ : ai₀ = ai₀✝) (at₀
    at₀✝ : w64) (e_at₀ : at₀ = at₀✝) (c₀ c₀✝ : w64) (e_c₀ : c₀ = c₀✝) (x₀ x₀✝ : apply.ApplyKV) (e_x₀
    : x₀ = x₀✝) (m m✝ : lease.Mode) (e_m : m = m✝) : etcdstart.memberBuilt s ρ E₀ lg γn id N served
    ai₀ at₀ c₀ x₀ m = etcdstart.memberBuilt s✝ ρ✝ E₀✝ lg✝ γn✝ id✝ N✝ served✝ ai₀✝ at₀✝ c₀✝ x₀✝ m✝

    apply.ApplyKV) (e_x₀ : x₀ = x₀✝) (N N✝ : Nat) (e_N : N = N✝) : srvBuilt s γ ci TM E ρ γr Er γn b
